{{Quote|My name is Madel Felth, Imperial Intelligence, and I am here to stop a revolution.|Medel Felth, on her operations against the resistance in the [[Duros Sector]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Madel Felth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] as an agent of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. For part of the war she was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. She tasked a fellow Imperial with eliminating a [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] called [[The Flame]].<ref name="TOR" />
